sources.title: Independent current CPU scoring and arithmetic
Per-question versus per-task averaging
sources.details: For task t with n_t questions and c_t correct, equal-question mean is Σc_t/Σn_t=Σ[n_t/(Σn_t)](c_t/n_t), so task weight grows with n_t. Equal-task mean is (1/T)Σ(c_t/n_t). With the joint table: 78/90=0.8666666666666667, while 12-task equal mean=0.8888888888888888; exact code proof records both. Counts are denominators and do not themselves supply c_t.
